sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: You've Got Mail is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come in, come in! I've got something for you to do. It's a personal matter. I sent a letter just before all this mess started in Tarkov. And now I don't think it's worth it to stir it all up. Not the time. Would you look in the post office and see if my letter is still there?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Obtain the registered mail on Streets of Tarkov
- Hand over the letter

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Did you find it? Phew, that's a load off my mind. You haven't read it, have you? Better not."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Registered letter | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
In this quest you have to find a letter in the post office on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: In the top left slightly opened drawer of the right cabinet behind the counter.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: On the ground behind the counter between the sport bag and the dead Scav.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: In the bottom right compartment of the right shelf below the counter.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: In the adjacent storage room on the bottom of a shelf between packages.
